g.text: How sentiment composition varies with text features
Fixed descriptive bins show associations without treating labels 0, 1 and 2 as numerical scores.
Source: clean_v2. Percentages use the n shown below each bin. Bins are descriptive choices, not tuned model thresholds.
Associations may reflect topic and label generation; no causal or predictive claim is made.
